I was driving in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas, when I moved left to change lanes. As I

pushing me toward the median before I could regain control. I pulled onto the shoulder right after the impact. I have
described the events the same way each time I have spoken with anyone about them, and I have nothing to add or
change. I am also the driver of this car as a member of the policyholder's household, since I live at the same address
and am listed as a household member on the policy. Since the collision, I have had stiffness and pain in my neck and
lower back, which I first noticed that evening and which has continued since then.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
